prompt:
Audit the conditioning image and the generated video, using only directly visible evidence. The condition is NOT a reference continuation. Evaluate each category separately; uncertainty in one must not erase the others.

First compare visible features at the registered video frame anchors listed with the video. For every category cite native evidence_frames (integer frame indices from that list) and a concrete observation. Then choose assessable, present, severity and basis. A temporal judgement requires at least two distinct registered frames. For condition_inconsistency use ONLY evidence_frames [0] and compare the generated start to the separate conditioning image. A later object leaving the table or frame is NOT an initial-condition mismatch.

Use exactly these meanings:
- abnormal_deformation: nonrigid change of the object's shape or contour. Rigid rotation, flipping, translation and perspective alone are NOT deformation. Identify an actual changing shape feature, not just motion. Positive basis: nonrigid_shape_change.
- identity_change: object replacement or disappearance inconsistent with visibility. Moving out of frame or behind another object does NOT prove disappearance. Positive basis: object_replacement or unexplained_disappearance.
- interpenetration: visibly impossible overlap. Occlusion alone is NOT penetration. Positive basis: impossible_overlap.
- camera_motion: displacement of the static background/viewpoint, not movement of foreground objects. Positive basis: static_scene_displacement.
- condition_inconsistency: generated frame 0 contradicts the conditioning image. Later motion or outcome is irrelevant to this category. Positive basis: initial_state_mismatch.

Return one JSON object with these five category keys, confidence (0..1) and insufficient_evidence (boolean). Each category has exactly: assessable (boolean), present (boolean), severity (integer 0..3), evidence (nonempty string describing a specific visible feature/comparison), evidence_frames (array of registered native indices), basis (one of the strings specified here). Assessable absence uses present=false, severity=0, basis=visible_consistency, with concrete visible supporting evidence. Unassessable uses assessable=false, present=false, severity=0, basis=not_observable and explains the visibility limitation; indices may be empty when no frame supports a judgement. UNKNOWN is not no violation. Set insufficient_evidence=true only when none of the five categories can be assessed. Never infer unseen contact, motion between sampled frames, or a hidden physical parameter. Do not output Markdown, placeholders, or an example. Visual judgement does not establish physical correctness.

Output rules: basis is a short machine-readable ENUM, NEVER an explanatory sentence. Put your visual explanation only in evidence. present MUST equal (severity > 0); if you see no violation, use present=false and severity=0. If unassessable, use assessable=false, present=false, severity=0, basis=not_observable. A condition judgement compares ONLY generated frame 0 with the conditioning image, not any later frame.
Required NESTED JSON structure (types/enums only, NOT example judgements; replace each specification with one observed value):
{"abnormal_deformation": {"evidence": nonempty_string, "evidence_frames": array_of_registered_frame_indices, "assessable": boolean, "present": boolean, "severity": integer_0_to_3, "basis": enum(nonrigid_shape_change | visible_consistency | not_observable)}, "identity_change": {"evidence": nonempty_string, "evidence_frames": array_of_registered_frame_indices, "assessable": boolean, "present": boolean, "severity": integer_0_to_3, "basis": enum(object_replacement | unexplained_disappearance | visible_consistency | not_observable)}, "interpenetration": {"evidence": nonempty_string, "evidence_frames": array_of_registered_frame_indices, "assessable": boolean, "present": boolean, "severity": integer_0_to_3, "basis": enum(impossible_overlap | visible_consistency | not_observable)}, "camera_motion": {"evidence": nonempty_string, "evidence_frames": array_of_registered_frame_indices, "assessable": boolean, "present": boolean, "severity": integer_0_to_3, "basis": enum(static_scene_displacement | visible_consistency | not_observable)}, "condition_inconsistency": {"evidence": nonempty_string, "evidence_frames": [0], "assessable": boolean, "present": boolean, "severity": integer_0_to_3, "basis": enum(initial_state_mismatch | visible_consistency | not_observable)}, "confidence": number_0_to_1, "insufficient_evidence": boolean}
Each category MUST be an object with these six fields, NEVER a boolean. Use each key once. Do not copy type specifications. Use only directly observed features; do not invent objects or reinterpret rigid motion as deformation.
